verifiedMechanisms: The final case authorization and host revalidation execute before preferences authorization and the final joint C08 read.
The private preferences namespace is read-authorized again after external callbacks; read does not request write authority.
A single final C08 callback captures the decision, reviewed result, producer result and private binding; full digests and authority are compared before returning the final binding.
No external product callback follows that final C08 read; request cancellation is checked before releasing the value.

The new parameterized regression uses one consumed real UI lease, real SQLite/C08 transactions and real result-store read/write. The private binding writer uses the same WeakSet as the state provider.

The membership variant commits a real CAS during the second preview authorizeCase call while global UI authority remains valid. The preferences variant denies only private read access after the same callback, preserving case access.
Result-store callbacks use a separate authorizeCase function, so the preview-specific two-callback counter does not count nested result authorization.

The positive baseline denies preferences writes before reading, proving the reader does not acquire write authority. All calculation, promotion, prepare and dispatch callbacks are non-returning guards and asserted unused.

authorizationScopeReview.stateProvider: product/host-binding/state-provider.ts returns a cloned entire C08 state inside one Dashboard SQLite transaction; final namespace authorization is revalidated inside that transaction.
authorizationScopeReview.productionGrantRevision: product/integration/product-authority.ts includes namespace grants in accessRevision. The final cases authority digest therefore also rejects a changed production namespace grant.

proofBoundaries: The case, historical choice, source evidence references and private binding are deliberately seeded for reader isolation. They do not prove a canonical financial calculation, human choice journey or native session.
Financial totals remain unknown/null; no formula or arithmetic is asserted in this regression.
